title: timing-scenarios.json — interface timing scenarios (authored, never derived)
description: One entry per interface timing scenario; the simulation-plan agent authors one sequence per entry. Authored by the specification stage's Wave 1. design.md §1.5 keeps the waveform diagrams and their phase-by-phase descriptions — those are the part a table could never hold — and points here for the scenario rows. Values are free prose; no script parses inside a field.

id.description: Scenario identifier, e.g. SC-001. One sequence is authored per id.

interface_mode.description: Optional. The interface group(s) or operating mode the scenario drives.

stimulus.description: What is driven to trigger the scenario.

timing_constraint.description: The timing obligation the scenario must satisfy.

exceptions.description: Optional. Exception and negative-case behaviour for this scenario.
